messages.author: cb0312e9c60a7720
messages.subject: update SSL certificate file in shinyapps.io RCurl library
parts:
Hi,

I got following message using RCurl on one of the source systems I'm trying to connect:

server certificate verification failed. CAfile: /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/RCurl/CurlSSL/cacert.pem CRLfile: none

Any way to upload updated certificate file to my library?
Other 3 sources are working well.

Regards,
Jan

messages.author: cb0312e9c60a7720
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] update SSL certificate file in shinyapps.io RCurl library
parts:
Hello Andy,

Thank you for the answer and the link to your cacert.pem.
My package is using by default CA cert file taken from system.file("CurlSSL", "cacert.pem", package = "RCurl") and this particular CA cert was not up to date.
I was able to fix the issue by setting RCurlOptions cainfo = system.file("cert", "cacert.pem", package = "shinyapps").
Still is might be worth to consider to update RCurl CA file manually to prevent other dependencies (like my Rbitcoin package) from throwing errors.

Regards,
Jan

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] update SSL certificate file in shinyapps.io RCurl library
parts:
The problem with that approach is that the shinyapps package does not get installed on your application instances when you deploy your application because the shinyapps package itself is not a detected dependency of your code.

To workaround this you should put the CAfile in your application directory and reference it via its relative path e.g:

RCurlOptions cainfo = "cacert.pem"

Or you could incude the CAcert  file in Rbitcoin package, as we have done in shinyapps:

RCurlOptions cainfo = system.file("cert", "cacert.pem", package = "Rbitcoin")

However, the underlying issue is that the CACert shipping with RCurl is out of date. My other suggestion would be to reach out to the RCurl package maintainer and see if he will update it, and push a new version to CRAN.

-Andy
